price_basis: Prices and mileages are the middle half of asking prices and odometer readings for that model year among used and certified cars in California. Cargo volume is the roomiest luggage figure EPA lists for that model year. Curb weight is the middle NHTSA crash-test figure for that model year. A brand's country is where the company is based, not where that car was built. The SUV comparison uses those same summaries for a short list of common SUVs. This is not an offer for a specific vehicle.
